scientific_integrity: The exact finite-power formula and its analytic proof are distinguished from exact-rational checks at finitely many degrees. The classical spectral eigenvalues, endpoint limit, and relevant spline bounds are explicitly attributed to prior literature. No numerical test is used as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: For each fixed integer degree only; the asymptotic remainder constants are not uniform in the degree. The Perron amplitude H_n is given by a finite positive eigenvector formula, not an elementary closed expression for arbitrary n. Full historic priority remains subject to independent review.
title: Midpoint rigidity and parity-accelerated endpoint norms of Bernstein overiterates
